reviews.review: I probably laughted few times at the animations, at the story, at some of lines and characters voices. The graphics aren't so impressive, and so the music isn't. There aren't many levels and some of them are way too short, and the truly challenge is only at the end of the game. But you know what? I really enjoyed my time with Banzai Escape. If you like on-rails shooter games, give it a try. I'm also happy to see that the second game is coming soon!
